summary: Transform your business acumen with our Data Analytics for Business Growth and Development Course. Master data-driven strategies for effective growth.
lede: Data Analytics for Business Growth and Development helps you connect customer behavior, sales conversion, retention, margin, channel performance, and operational capacity to commercial outcomes. Using a structured CRISP-DM workflow, you will learn to define measurable questions, validate data, calculate key performance indicators, interpret patterns, and identify opportunities for growth. You will practice SQL, Excel data preparation, Power BI data modelling, descriptive statistics, cohort analysis, RFM segmentation, funnel analysis, and dashboard design. Through hands-on business datasets, you will create decision-ready deliverables, assess data quality, interpret an A/B test scenario, and develop growth recommendations with clear assumptions and success measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use commercial, customer, financial, or operational data to support growth decisions. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need practical analysis skills without requiring advanced programming.
modules: Power BI Models and KPI Dashboards
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of using a modern web browser and spreadsheet software. The course provides structured practice datasets, SQL examples, Excel templates, Power BI dashboard exercises, KPI worksheets, and reporting templates. You do not need to install Python or build production machine-learning models. Access to Power BI Desktop or an equivalent business intelligence environment may improve the hands-on experience, but the facilitator can provide alternative workbook-based activities where licensing or device access differs.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
